answer: Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The nadir holds work receipts rather than names, so the copper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
